'''Dark Lord of the Sith Power overwhelming''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]
* '''Published:''' 7 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Power overwhelming
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 PO Sith LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Lots of kool characters, lots of jedi's, lots of lightsabers, dont think you want to try and kill them all.

The published list has 63 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 63 as published (GPN category Scenario; no objective or starting cards): Characters (18) header but 17 characters listed; other sections match their headers.
* Docking Bay 94 x2 as posted (unique site).

== Strategy ==

I don't think i really have a strategy. I just put the cards out as i get them. I think if i had one it would be to kill my opponent by battleing and always have more power.
